purpose: Closure record for the selector-cold-start-recalibration subtree: its branch ended in a pre-registered negative result and was closed, but its committed material (dormant evaluation surface, wire-contract guards, dataset extractor, preregistrations, tests) is the substrate the cold-quota lane builds on. This merge preserves that material in the parent branch while keeping the negative verdict in force.

merge.merge_base_check: 82003ed was already an ancestor of c1f5fa2, so the merge is the branch content itself with no conflict resolution and no content authored by this node

commit_list.subject: Pre-register the cold-start selector design and its acceptance numbers before any fit has seen the data
Build the cold-start candidate dataset: read-only extractor scripts/recall_map_coldstart_dataset.py
Fit the revised relevance policy on the cold-start train split, verify on eval, evaluate once on the sealed holdout
Thread the RecallResult through _pool to the scorer, changing no score
Re-register the cold-start selector under a new sealed plan whose scorer shape can actually fit
Turn the frozen sel wire contract from a promise into merged executable guards
Land the enlarged cold-start population and publish the independence accounting
Build the dormant rank-calibration evaluation surface in recall_map.py
Seal the plan that answers the recorded step-3 HALT, before any number is read under it
Run the sealed v3 procedure and record the pre-registered negative result: guard (c) fails

negative_result_preserved.meaning: The revised scorer would have cost warm-cohort precision at matched admission volume (0.607 vs 0.641), so re-scoring the whole pool with it is refuted. The refutation is the reason the successor lane is a bounded cold QUOTA beside the frozen scorer, not a replacement of it.

refs.reason: Stale parent-node worktree snapshot: it carries pre-v3 versions of policy.json (11631 lines smaller), scripts/recall_map_coldstart_fit.py and the coldstart tests — strictly superseded by the committed branch head c1f5fa2 it sits on top of.
Tree is byte-identical to the merged branch head c1f5fa2 (git diff c1f5fa2..f8d4379 is empty); nothing exists there that the branch does not already carry.

dormant_material_now_in_parent.carries: Dormant rank-calibration evaluation surface, executable frozen-sel wire-contract guards (positional codes never reordered, canonical trailing-zero trim), and RecallResult threaded through _pool to the scorer with no score change. All inert without env valves.
Read-only extractor that rebuilds the recall-residual candidate population (train/eval/holdout splits) from live recall_events.
The v1/v2/v3 fit and sealed-decision-procedure runner, including the mechanical plan-sha verification and HALT semantics.
The three sealed preregistrations and their design rationales; v3 is the plan whose mechanical run produced the negative result.
Suites pinning the extractor and the fit/decision procedure.
coldstart_revision block recording the sealed run, its guards, and the not-wireable verdict; selected_policy deliberately NOT bumped.

downstream: cold-quota-lane-build depends on this merge: it arms a bounded cold-quota admission lane behind inert valves on top of the dormant surface and wire-contract guards preserved here, under cold-quota-prereg.json, instead of re-fitting the pool scorer that guard (c) refuted.
